about: Server-side PQ pins at the full verifier (verifyPCActn `pqPins`: grant issuer -> the PQ public key the server pins for it). Each case takes the named vectors.json vector (grant, PCActn, context) and supplies `pq_pins`; `$grant.issuer` and `$grant.pq_pk` stand for that vector's grant (`$grant.pq_pk[0:20]` is its first 20 characters); a JSON key `$grant.issuer` in `pq_pins` is the grant issuer. Compared: the `pq_pin` check status and, on a fail, the exact reason (it appears among the verdict reasons). An Ed25519 grant from an issuer with NO own pin entry passes whatever the other pins are; an Ed25519 grant from an issuer that HAS an own pin entry (any value) is refused: `pq_pin: the grant issuer is pinned to a post-quantum key; a classical grant is refused`. A non-Ed25519 (pure-PQ or hybrid) grant passes iff `pq_pins` has an OWN entry for its issuer that is byte-equal to the grant pq_pk; a missing entry is `no server-side PQ pin ...`, a different one `... does not match ...`. `pq_pins` omitted: the check is not reported at all (`pq_pin` absent from the checks). Pin lookups use own properties only. Generated by scripts/gen-conformance-hardening.mjs; proved against the reference by src/hardening-vectors.test.ts.

pq_pin.name: ed25519-grant-empty-pins
pq_pin.description: An Ed25519 grant needs no pin.

pq_pin.name: ed25519-grant-unrelated-pin
pq_pin.description: An Ed25519 grant passes whatever the pins contain.

pq_pin.name: ed25519-grant-pinned-issuer
pq_pin.description: A classical grant from an issuer that has a PQ pin is refused: the pin would otherwise protect nothing (anyone with the issuer Ed25519 key mints a classical grant).

expect.reason: pq_pin: the grant issuer is pinned to a post-quantum key; a classical grant is refused

pq_pin.name: pq-grant-pinned
pq_pin.description: The pin equals the grant pq_pk.

pq_pin.name: pq-grant-empty-pins
pq_pin.description: No pin for the issuer (empty pins).

expect.reason: pq_pin: no server-side PQ pin for the grant issuer (suite ml-dsa-65)

expect.reason: pq_pin: no server-side PQ pin for the grant issuer (suite ml-dsa-65)

pq_pin.name: pq-grant-different-pin
pq_pin.description: The issuer is pinned to a different PQ key.
